items.item: A breadcrumb leads back to the contracts list and ends with the contract number, and the header shows the contract number, vendor name, a status badge with text, and at most four key fields (such as value, start and end date)
items.evidence: nav[aria-label=Breadcrumb] 'Hợp đồng / HD-2026-0187'; header shows 'Mã HD-2026-0187', vendor link 'Công ty TNHH Thép Việt Phát', badges 'Đang hiệu lực' and 'Hết hạn sau 56 ngày'; dl has exactly four fields (Nhà cung cấp, Giá trị hợp đồng, Hiệu lực, Đã thanh toán).

items.item: The header has one primary action (such as "Renew contract") and puts other actions such as edit or terminate in a secondary or overflow position
items.evidence: #btnRenewal 'Đề xuất gia hạn' is the only filled button; #btnMore (kebab, menu role) holds 'Chỉnh sửa thông tin', 'Tải bản PDF', 'Nhân bản', and 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng…' (red, separated).

items.item: Vendor contacts show each person's name and role, with email as a `mailto:` link and phone as a `tel:` link, and the primary contact is marked with text
items.evidence: viewContacts(): columns Họ tên / Chức vụ; href="mailto:...", href="tel:+84..."; primary gets badge 'Chính'.

items.item: Payment milestones show the due date, amount and status, with amounts right-aligned in tabular figures and formatted as currency, and the milestones are ordered with overdue and due-soon ones first
items.evidence: viewPayments(): columns Hạn thanh toán, Số tiền (VND) with 'text-right tabular-nums', Intl.NumberFormat vi-VN VND; sort by payGroup rank (0 overdue, 1 due soon, 2 rest) then due date; note 'Mốc quá hạn và sắp đến hạn được xếp lên đầu.'

items.item: Overdue or upcoming milestones are marked with a text label (such as "Overdue" or "Due in 5 days"), not by colour alone
items.evidence: payGroup() labels: 'Quá hạn 21 ngày', 'Sắp đến hạn – còn 15 ngày', rendered as text badges; summary line also says 'Quá hạn <amount>'.

items.item: The renewal or expiry date is shown as an absolute date with the remaining time stated in words (such as "Expires in 45 days")
items.evidence: Header badge 'Hết hạn sau 56 ngày' with 'Hiệu lực 01/01/2026 – 31/12/2026'; Gia hạn tab 'Hết hạn 31/12/2026 · còn 56 ngày' and notice deadline '01/12/2026 · còn 26 ngày'.

items.item: Amendments are listed with number, date, a short summary and who approved them, using absolute dates
items.evidence: viewAddenda() has number (PL-01), title summary, effective date dd/mm/yyyy, value change, status, file; there is no approver column or field in the addenda data (approver appears only in the history log for PL-03, not in the list).

items.item: Each section has an empty state with a next action (such as "Add contact" or "Add amendment"), a loading state, and an inline error with retry
items.evidence: Empty states with actions exist for terms ('Thêm điều khoản'), contacts ('Thêm người liên hệ'), payments, addenda ('Tạo phụ lục'), renewal ('Tạo đề xuất gia hạn'); skeleton() loading and errorBox() with 'Thử lại' (data-act=retry) apply to every tab. But viewHistory() empty state has message only, no next action; error/empty are reachable only via ?state= params.

items.item: Terminating the contract asks for confirmation that names the contract and the consequence, with a verb button label and focus not on the destructive button
items.evidence: case 'terminate': confirmDlg('Chấm dứt hợp đồng HD-2026-0187?', 'Hợp đồng với Công ty TNHH Thép Việt Phát sẽ chuyển sang trạng thái Đã chấm dứt. 3 mốc thanh toán... sẽ bị hủy. Không thể hoàn tác.', 'Chấm dứt hợp đồng', ...); openDlg focuses only input/textarea/select (none present), so showModal default focus lands on the first button 'Hủy' (Cancel precedes the danger button in DOM).

tells: gradient (only the loading skeleton shimmer, linear-gradient in .skel; no gradient on surfaces)
notes: Plain, restrained enterprise layout: sidebar is white, no KPI tiles, no greeting, no emoji, no hover-lift, radii 4-6px, audit score 100. Initials avatars are used for real people (contacts) so not counted as a tell. Main gaps: addenda lack an approver; History empty state has no next action; error state only reachable via query param. The header 'Đã thanh toán' key field is fine. Contract title is a descriptive name while the contract number sits in the subtitle line.
